## Wyrmling River Dragon (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 CN Tiny Dragon (aquatic, fire)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +4 natural, +2 size)  
 **hp** 30 (4d12+4)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +7, **Will** +5  
 **Immune** fire, dragon traits  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +6 (1d4)  
 **Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft. (5 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (30-ft. line, DC 12, 2d6 fire)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 11, **Dex** 17, **Con** 12, **Int** 9, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 15 (19 vs, trip)  
 **Feats** Athletic, Improved Initiative  
 **Skills** Knowledge (nature) +6, Perception +8, Stealth +18, Survival +8, Swim +17; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Draconic  
 **SQ** air breathing  

**Special Abilities**

 **Air Breathing (Ex)**  The river dragon can breathe air just as naturally as water. This dragon can freely use its breath weapon, spells and other abilities in both air and water.

  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate aquatic
